data.content_ref: inline:{"analogy":null,"claim":"The three consecutive even integers summing to 138 are 44, 46, and 48, making the largest 48.","counterconditions":[{"case":"If 138 were not divisible by 3, the arithmetic mean would be non-integer and no equally spaced triple of integers could sum to 138.","checker_spec":null,"eval":"observation"},{"case":"If the problem required consecutive odd integers instead of even, 46 would be the wrong parity and no valid triple would exist.","checker_spec":null,"eval":"observation"},{"case":"If the constraint that the integers are consecutive and spaced by 2 were removed, other triples could sum to 138 (e.g., 40, 46, 52) and the largest would not be determined.","checker_spec":null,"eval":"observation"}],"definitions":[],"derivation":[],"formalization_refs":[],"mechanism":"Let the three consecutive even integers be x, x+2, and x+4.
